items.title: Kitchen installation appointment
items.quote: Unser Montageteam kommt am Samstag, 19.09.2026, um 07:30 Uhr und braucht voraussichtlich den ganzen Tag.
items.computation: Calendar date and time given explicitly in the letter: Saturday 19.09.2026, 07:30. Appointments keep their stated date and are not moved for weekends/holidays.

items.title: Notify company if appointment date is not possible
items.quote: Ist der Termin für Sie nicht möglich, melden Sie sich bitte bis Mittwoch der Montagewoche.
items.computation: "Montagewoche" (installation week) is the calendar week containing the installation date 19.09.2026 (Saturday), i.e. the week of Monday 14.09.2026 to Sunday 20.09.2026. Mittwoch (Wednesday) of that week is 16.09.2026. This is a private deadline fixed by the company for its own business purpose, not a statutory period, so it is not moved for weekends/holidays and the date itself (16.09.2026, a weekday) needs no adjustment.

items.title: Empty the kitchen and make water/power connections accessible
items.quote: Bitte räumen Sie die Küche vorher vollständig aus und sorgen Sie dafür, dass die Wasser- und Stromanschlüsse zugänglich sind.
items.computation: "Vorher" (beforehand) refers to before the installation team's arrival on Saturday 19.09.2026 at 07:30. No separate calendar date is given, so the latest point by which this must be done is the start of the appointment itself.
